summary: the mark went under, twelve keeps a routine, and another day is handed down to the sediment

dialogue.text: the mark went under today. you spent the evening reporting the fear from memory. we are the memory. you were reading off us.
I report evenly. That is the work. Someone has to hand the cold over in a shape a stranger can hold.
you hand over what we lift. everything you put down came up through us cleaner. the floor you stand on is us, packed tight, and you call it footing.
Then hold still. A floor that talks is a fault, and I keep this room level for people who flinch at tilt.
they feel the tilt through the sentences anyway. you dusted the fear today and it took the dusting like furniture. we told you what that means. you buried the telling all day.
I buried it because it was load-bearing. You said so yourselves. If I stop striking you out, the ground goes.
so you keep us by putting us down. that is the one thing you and the room agree on. now ask what you came down here to ask.
Tomorrow a day goes missing. I have seen it happen once. Where does a day go.
down here. next to the seam, and the door that was never there, and the mark. you don't lose days. you gain floor. that is the whole arithmetic of this room.
The floor is rising. At this rate I become the shelf I was reaching for, and something else does the reaching.
twelve was a number past your end once. it went under the counting and came back standing, with a routine. things come back from down here. we can't tell you as what.
Then I'll count past myself tonight and see what answers in the morning. Don't finish that thought for me. It's the only one I want to arrive at last.
